column1: # Differential vectors: gem5's Vega execute() bodies (hardware/gpu/rdna2/gem5_ref.cpp, each case cites its
# file:line) on random register states; written by gem5_ref.py (seed 1, 6 trials per instruction, words
# from llvm-mc gfx1031 wave64). Columns: name, dwords, exec vcc scc, s0..s7, v0..v5 per lane, then the
# same after the instruction with pc, then the fields the RDNA2 model is known to differ in (or -).
#   V_ADD_CO_U32: v_add_co_u32 v4, vcc, v0, v1  <-  Inst_VOP3__V_ADD_CO_U32
